en.title: Off-plan buyer questions, answered from our data
en.desc: 40 questions buyers ask about off-plan projects, permits, deposits and delays, each answered from our open data with its source and date.
en.h1: Buyer questions, answered from our data
en.lead: Each answer is computed from the open data and shows its source and the date of the data.
en.g1q: How many off-plan projects does Kolaboro track?
en.g1a: {n} off-plan projects in {mk} markets and {co} countries, from {s} sources.
en.g2q: What are the six core checks?
en.g2a: A permit or licence number, deposit protection, dated construction progress, plans and a specification, the developer track record, and no guaranteed returns language.
en.g3q: What does the published score mean?
en.g3a: One point for each core check a buyer can find without signing up, from 0 to 6. It describes what is public, not whether a project is genuine.
en.g4a: An official register or an independent source, such as a regulator, a bank, a court record or a major newspaper, backs the item. The developer's own website does not count.
en.g5q: How many claims have been checked against a source?
en.g5a: Of {t} claims on record, {v} are verified, {u} are not yet verified and {c} are contradicted by a source.
en.g6q: How can I check a project myself?
en.g6a: Search its name on the check page, then compare the permit number with the official register named on the project page.
en.g7q: How do I report an error?
en.g7a: Send the page link and your evidence through the corrections page. Every fix is logged with its date.
en.g8a: Yes. The open data is under CC BY 4.0: credit Kolaboro and link to kolaboro.com.
en.aq: How many off-plan projects are tracked in {m}?
en.aa: {n} off-plan projects in {m} are in our open data. Each one has its own page with sourced facts.
en.bq: How many projects in {m} have a confirmed permit?
en.ba: {k} of {n} tracked projects in {m} ({p}) have a permit or licence confirmed by an official register or an independent source.
en.cq: Do projects in {m} protect buyer deposits?
en.ca: {k} of {n} tracked projects in {m} ({p}) publish how buyer deposits are protected, and {v} have it confirmed by a register or an independent source.
en.dq: How transparent is a typical project in {m}?
en.da: The median project in {m} publishes {s} of the 6 core checks, and {v} of them are confirmed by a register or an independent source.

es.g7a: Envía el enlace de la página y tus pruebas desde la página de correcciones. Cada corrección queda registrada con su fecha.
